title: Aka-uka janjallashdi, bitta shaharda nima paydo bo'ldi?
hook: 1948 yilda bitta oilaviy fabrika ikkiga bo'lindi.

scenes.text: 1948 yilda Germaniyaning kichik shahridagi oilaviy poyabzal fabrikasi ikkiga bo'lindi.
Uni 1924 yilda ikki aka-uka ochgan edi. 1936 yilgi Olimpiadada Jessi Ouens 4 ta oltin medal oldi, rivoyatga ko'ra ularning poyabzalida.
Keyin aka-ukalar orasi buzildi. Sababi haqida turli gaplar bor, aniq javob yo'q.
Akasi Rudolf Dassler Puma'ni ochdi. 1949 yilda ukasi Adolf Dassler Adidas'ni ro'yxatdan o'tkazdi.
Ikkala fabrika ham Hertsogenaurax shahrida qoldi. Bitta janjaldan ikki yirik sport brendi chiqdi.

description:
Adolf va Rudolf Dassler 1924 yilda Hertsogenauraxda poyabzal fabrikasi ochgan. 1948 yilda ular ajralishgan: Rudolf Puma'ni ochgan, Adolf 1949 yilda Adidas'ni ro'yxatdan o'tkazgan. Ikkala kompaniya ham shu shaharda qolgan.

Oilaviy biznes yaxshimi yoki xavflimi? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). adidas Group 75th anniversary release and adidas history page (Adolf Dassler adidas Sportschuhfabrik entered in the commercial register 18 Aug 1949; Owens won four golds in Berlin 1936, but adidas itself says evidence is inconclusive and that 'legend has it' he ran in Dassler spikes); HISTORY.com, Fortune 2013 and Wikipedia 'Dassler brothers feud' (Gebruder Dassler Schuhfabrik 1924 in Herzogenaurach; split 1948; Rudolf founded RUDA, renamed Puma in 1948; cause of feud disputed; firms on opposite banks of the Aurach). Fix: Owens shoe link is a popular account, now worded as a legend.
